```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

Modify the code below, to ADD a tooltip, which SHOWS
the sepal length.


#Use this hint of how to concatenate strings:
#tooltip = glue::glue("{name}: {scales::comma(population)}")


```{r}
iris_scatter <- ggplot(iris) + 
  aes(
    Sepal.Length, Sepal.Width,
    color = Species
  ) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(data_id = Species,
        tooltip = Sepal.Length),
    size = 2
  )
girafe(
  ggobj = iris_scatter,
  width_svg = 6,
  height_svg = 6*0.618,
  options = list(
    opts_hover(css = "fill: #202020;"),
    opts_hover_inv(css = "opacity: 0.2;")
  )
)
```
